SwitchPreference.android:title: Start at Boot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Automatically run the DirtyFrag exploit on device boot

SwitchPreference.android:title: Auto Soft-Reboot
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Works on both Manual Start and Start at Boot, Also turns on KSU modules after soft-rebooting.

SwitchPreference.android:title: Disable KSU Modules
SwitchPreference.android:summary: Turn this on if a broken KSU module is crashing your device. The next run will launch with all modules disabled.
